name: Butterflies
overview: While butterflies are not directly mentioned in Scripture, the transformation they undergo beautifully illustrates the spiritual truth of being born again and renewed in Christ. Just as the butterfly emerges changed from its former state, believers are called to be transformed by the renewing of their minds and to live out their salvation with reverent obedience. This new life brings comfort amid affliction through God's Word and is sustained by prayer and trust in His perfect will, reflecting the profound love God shows by giving His Son for our everlasting life.
